# windows_iis_binding (Resource)

Manages one IIS binding on a site on a remote Windows host via SSH and PowerShell (`WebAdministration` module: `New-WebBinding -SslFlags`, `Remove-WebBinding`, `AddSslCertificate` / `RemoveSslCertificate`, `Start-Website`).

The binding identity is `<site>|<protocol>|<bindingInformation>` (`bindingInformation` is `IP:port:hostheader`, e.g. `*:443:example.com`). `site_name`, `protocol`, `ip_address`, `port` and `host_header` identify the listener and are immutable after creation (ForceNew); `require_sni`, `certificate_thumbprint` and `certificate_store_name` are updated in place (the binding is removed and re-added with the new certificate/SNI pair in one script).

`certificate_thumbprint` and `require_sni` need `protocol = "https"`; `require_sni = true` additionally needs a `host_header` (SNI selects the certificate by server name). Certificates live in `Cert:\LocalMachine\<store>` and are managed by `windows_certificate` — they are never created implicitly, and a certificate without a private key is refused.

Safety: creating a binding on the SSH management port is refused fail-closed (`would_lock_out`): binding HTTP.sys to the port the provider's own session arrived on risks cutting the management connection.

Requires IIS on the target host: install it with the `windows_feature` resource (`Web-Server`; add `Web-Mgmt-Console` / `Web-Scripting-Tools` for the `WebAdministration` module on Server Core).

Import format: `<site>|<protocol>|<bindingInformation>` (e.g. `web|https|*:443:example.com`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Manage one IIS binding on a site: only the in-place attributes
# (require_sni, certificate_thumbprint, certificate_store_name) are written
# after creation; the identity (site, protocol, IP, port, host) is ForceNew.
#
# The site must already exist (windows_iis_site). Certificates live in
# Cert:\LocalMachine\<store> and are managed by windows_certificate — they
# are never created implicitly, and a certificate without a private key is
# refused. Binding the SSH management port is refused fail-closed
# (would_lock_out).
#
# Requires IIS on the target host (WebAdministration module): install it
# with windows_feature first (Web-Server; add Web-Mgmt-Console /
# Web-Scripting-Tools for the module on Server Core).
resource "windows_feature" "iis" {
  name                     = "Web-Server"
  include_management_tools = true
}

resource "windows_iis_site" "web" {
  name          = "web"
  physical_path = "C:\\inetpub\\wwwroot"

  depends_on = [windows_feature.iis]
}

# Plain HTTP binding (no certificate).
resource "windows_iis_binding" "http" {
  site_name   = windows_iis_site.web.name
  protocol    = "http"
  ip_address  = "*"
  port        = 80
  host_header = "example.com"

  depends_on = [windows_feature.iis]

  # Bound every remote operation explicitly. Without this block each operation
  # defaults to 10 minutes; a stalled PowerShell/SSH session then surfaces a
  # timeout diagnostic instead of blocking Terraform indefinitely.
  timeouts = {
    create = "10m"
    read   = "10m"
    update = "10m"
    delete = "10m"
  }
}

# HTTPS binding with SNI: require_sni needs a host header, and the
# certificate must already carry a private key.
resource "windows_iis_binding" "https" {
  site_name   = windows_iis_site.web.name
  protocol    = "https"
  ip_address  = "*"
  port        = 443
  host_header = "example.com"

  require_sni            = true
  certificate_thumbprint = "ABCDEF0123456789ABCDEF0123456789ABCDEF01"
  certificate_store_name = "My"

  depends_on = [windows_feature.iis]

  timeouts = {
    create = "10m"
    read   = "10m"
    update = "10m"
    delete = "10m"
  }
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `port` (Number) Port to listen on (1-65535). Binding the SSH management port is refused fail-closed (`would_lock_out`). Immutable after creation (ForceNew).
- `protocol` (String) Binding protocol. One of `http`, `https`. Immutable after creation (ForceNew).
- `site_name` (String) Owning IIS site. 1-64 characters; must not contain `/ \ [ ] : ; , ? * " < > |` and must not have leading or trailing spaces. The site must already exist (manage it with `windows_iis_site`); it is never created implicitly. Immutable after creation (ForceNew).

### Optional

- `certificate_store_name` (String) LocalMachine store holding the certificate. One of `My`, `WebHosting`. Only meaningful alongside `certificate_thumbprint`. Updated in place. Defaults to `My`.
- `certificate_thumbprint` (String) Thumbprint of the certificate to bind (`Cert:\LocalMachine\<store>`). 40 hex characters (spaces allowed, case-insensitive; stored upper-case without spaces). Needs `protocol = "https"`. The certificate must already exist (manage it with `windows_certificate`) and carry a private key. Omit (null) for no certificate. Updated in place.
- `host_header` (String) Host header (server name), stored lower-case. Empty means the catch-all binding. Must not contain `|`, `:` or whitespace. Required when `require_sni` is true. Immutable after creation (ForceNew). Defaults to `""`.
- `ip_address` (String) IP address to listen on, stored canonically (`netip`: lower-case, compressed IPv6). `"*"` listens on all unassigned addresses. Zone IDs are rejected. Immutable after creation (ForceNew). Defaults to `"*"`.
- `require_sni` (Boolean) Whether the binding requires Server Name Indication (`SslFlags` bit 0). Needs `protocol = "https"` and a non-empty `host_header`. Updated in place. Defaults to `false`.
- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `binding_information` (String) Canonical binding information (`IP:port:hostheader`, e.g. `*:443:example.com`; IPv6 addresses are bracketed).
- `id` (String) Resource identifier: `<site>|<protocol>|<bindingInformation>`.

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
- `delete` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Setting a timeout for a Delete operation is only applicable if changes are saved into state before the destroy operation occurs.
- `read` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Read operations occur during any refresh or planning operation when refresh is enabled.
- `update` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import a binding by <site>|<protocol>|<bindingInformation>. The live
# certificate/SNI pair is adopted into state; unconfigured in-place
# attributes reflect the observed values.
terraform import windows_iis_binding.https 'web|https|*:443:example.com'
```
